description: PROPOSED (Discussion #49), not yet finalized. error and verdict together. soul-sol/agent-watch's worker_watch.sh reports STALL when 'the outcome cannot be established at all' -- here its verbatim line 'STALL <name> — process exited but exit code is unavailable' (worker_launch.sh writes $? to <name>.exit; the file is missing). The harness failed to record how the run ended, so error.type is runner_error; but the worker ran and may have acted before exiting, so verdict: "unverified" is set. With error present, verdict MUST be absent or "unverified" (VERDICT_ERROR_CONFLICT otherwise). Setting verdict is the producer's explicit statement that this row MUST stay in result-level denominators and be counted as unverified, instead of being dropped the way a bare error row may be. A conforming validator MUST ACCEPT this document; both validation paths do.

error.message: STALL api_task — process exited but exit code is unavailable
